Bloomberg.t: Universal Music Subscription Revenue Growth Shows Improvement
Bloomberg.s: Universal Music Group NV reported an increase in subscription revenue in the third quarter, buoyed by price increases and “healthy” subscriber growth, helping the world’s largest music label bounce back after two disappointing periods.

Bloomberg.s: El accidente ferroviario más mortífero de España en más de una década llega a un mes de las elecciones y aumenta el escrutinio sobre Pedro Sánchez, mientras la seguridad y el deterioro de la infraestructura pública ganan peso en el debate político. (Source: Bloomberg)

Bloomberg.t: Lenders Seek to Sell Debt of Rovensa as Firm Burns Through Cash
Bloomberg.s: Lenders to Partners Group-backed Rovensa are looking to offload the debt of the Iberian agricultural products maker as the firm burns through cash.

Bloomberg.ss: ABD hisse senedi vadeli kontratları, yatırımcıların mega büyük teknoloji şirketlerinden elde edilen karışık kazançlara ağırlık vermesi ve Federal Reserve'ün Aralık ayındaki bir artışın olası olup olmadığına dair bir sinyal vermeden faiz oranlarını sabit tutmasıyla Asya ticaretinde düştü.

Bloomberg.t: Lula’s Top Court Problem: Moraes Passport Order Angers Brazil’s President

Bloomberg.t: Polymarket Investigates Suspicious Trades on Israel Election
Bloomberg.s: Polymarket is investigating a string of well-timed and profitable trades on the Israeli election this week in the latest case to raise concerns about potential insider trading on prediction markets.

Bloomberg.t: Paschi Investors Deal Crushing Blow to CEO in Win for Intesa
Bloomberg.s: Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena SpA’s investors overwhelmingly rejected the main element of CEO Luigi Lovaglio’s defense against a takeover by Intesa Sanpaolo SpA, setting up the world’s oldest bank for the potential loss of its independence.

Bloomberg.t: The Fearsome Rise of the Haunted Attraction
Bloomberg.s: Once low-tech staples of Halloween carnivals, haunted houses have become elaborate immersive environments that can draw crowds to forgotten parts of US cities. David Dudley reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

Bloomberg.t: Chipotle Sales Beat as New Chicken, Chips Bring Diners Back
Bloomberg.s: Chipotle Mexican Grill Inc. sales rose faster than expected in the third quarter, as more frequent menu launches and revamped loyalty offers help sustain a recovery that had been threatened by a food-illness scare. Bloomberg's Michael Halen joins to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)
